answer: Delay economic rights until a key survives probation from the dawn of its first epoch, ending only after distinct counterparties countersign real deliveries. Sponsorship grows like a willow: each established key may midwife only a slowly rising cap of newcomers, and each child inherits the sponsor's slash for coordinated clones. Before payout, a prism of independent checks—payload novelty, clock-skew clusters, reused settlement routes—must all pass, so one operator cannot clear every slice with identical farms. Mass aliases cost unique work and inherited liability, not just new keypairs.
